dataList.content:
I thought the Sinners were doomed to chew uncomfortably through this incredibly awkward meal, but Jia Mu and her retinue of Heishou left the banquet hall quite promptly after that exchange. It was as though they had no more reason to remain here.
我原以为之后还会继续有尴尬的聚餐场合，但贾母和黑兽们似乎觉得没有继续留在这里的理由，很快就离开了宴会厅。
dataList.place:
Daguanyuan - Dahuating Banquet Hall
大观园 大花厅 宴会厅

dataList.content:
It is odd, that they should inquire Hong Lu of his departure plans on the very welcoming of his return.
真是异常，他们一见到鸿璐就问起他将何时离开。

Right…? One moment it appears like they really care about him, then…
是啊……明明刚才还那么珍视他……

The appearance of that 'care' for one's own child was also quite distinct and unusual compared to the typical display of emotional intimacy expressed in average households.
即便是他们慈祥的样子，也和普通家庭中疼爱孩子的表现有些不一样之处。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Hey, Baoyu.
宝玉。

That's when an unfamiliar, chipper voice hopped jovially into our conversation.
那时，一个陌生的活泼声音突然插入了我们的对话。

Why didn’t you come see me first? I’ve been staying in the same building ever since you departed here, you know?
为什么不先来见我呢？我的住所自你离家以来都未曾改变。

Aha, big sis Xue Baochai. It’s been so long.
啊，是宝钗姐姐呀。好久不见。

You’ve come all the way to my welcome banquet to fill a seat? I appreciate that.
你专程过来捧场了呢。太感谢了。

Had I known that you’d be coming home today, Baoyu, I would’ve summoned everyone I could from my family to see you, too. Big bro Pan’s really been itching to know how you’ve been doing.
要是早知道宝玉要来，我会把薛家其他人也叫上的。蟠哥哥不知有多惦记宝玉的安危呢。

... Yeah, sure he was.
……那可不是嘛。
dataList.title:
Jia Family
贾家

dataList.content:
Xichun, who’d been sitting in complete silence for the entire banquet, muttered quietly to herself.
一直保持着沉默的惜春轻声嘀咕道。

Who else have you greeted since you arrived today, Baoyu?
宝玉，回来后都见过谁了？

My parents and Jia Mu.
刚才向父母和老太太请安了。

Really? So I’m your first, then?
真的？那我就是第一个啦。

She made a cheerful remark before leaning close up to his eye.
她开心地说着，将自己的脸凑近了鸿璐的眼睛。

Your jade is always so glimmering and pristine, Baoyu.
你的玉无论何时都那么熠熠生辉、纯洁无瑕呢，宝玉。

Look, I made myself a necklace in the same color as your eye and wore it every single day to constantly remind myself of you. Well, do you see it?
你离开后，为了不忘记你，我做了条颜色一模一样的项链天天戴着。怎么样，看到了吗？

Oh, you have. Thank you for remembering me.
原来如此。谢谢你一直记着我。

Ahem, ahem. So… are you gonna introduce her to us, orrrr…?
咳嗯，所以……这位是谁呀？

Hey… Why couldn’t we just let that nice reunion play out? Man…
唉……真是难得气氛这么好，怎么就忍不住呢……

Rodya stepped forward, unable to stand the curiosity.
结果，好奇心占了上风的罗佳向前迈了一步。

Oh, she's—
啊，她是——

Hi, I'm Baochai. Baochai of the Xue family. I have a very profound relationship with dear Baoyu here.
我叫宝钗，薛家宝钗。和宝玉有着深厚的缘分呢。

A very profound relationship?
深厚的缘分？

Hehe, he is my betrothed, and I to him. I'd say that's pretty profound, hmm?
呵呵，都已经订下婚约了，怎能说缘分不深呢？
WHAAAT??!! 什么？？！！

It's nothing to be surprised about. These 'profound relationships' can be established effortlessly in the simple exchange of agreements between our elders.
不必这么惊讶。因长辈们的随口约定而结下的缘分，本就稀松平常。

H-hey, you coulda at least given us a hint!
不、不是！你至少该先给我们做点心理准备啊！

Mm... but I won't be married until I leave Limbus Company, though?
嗯……反正我就算要结婚也是在离开边狱公司之后了吧？

I just thought that it wasn't relevant enough to share.
我只是觉得没必要特意告知而已啦。

So… sorry about overhearing earlier, but you guys are Baoyu’s friends, right?
那个，刚才稍微听到了一些……你们是宝玉的朋友对吧？

I’ve been so, so curious to hear what kind of life Baoyu lived out there. Care to share some tales of your journey with me?
我实在太好奇宝玉至今过着怎样的生活了，如果可以的话，能请你们给我讲讲你们的旅行故事吗？

Don't have stories for kids. Shoo.
小孩子一边儿去。这可不是能随便听的故事。

Why? But I loooove stories about bloodshed!
为什么呀？我可是超~喜欢那些血腥的故事了呢！

Ah, one of big sister Baochai’s pastimes was curating creepy stories of urban legends.
啊，宝钗姐姐的兴趣之一就是收集都市怪谈的故事书呢。

Puff… then maybe I’ll share some.
呼……那我就稍微讲点吧。

Wah~ What about everyone else? I love, love, love adventure stories.
哇~其他人呢？我可是超喜欢冒险故事呢。

Be careful what you wish for…
说了这话，你有以后不会后悔的自信吗？

Ah... I beseech thee to find a seat, for I shall now regale thee with a tale in which an adventure of most wondrous valor unfolds; brace thyself, for this particularly olden and terrifying tale features a big, scary bear lurking in a cavern...
那么……请汝坐下，吾现在将要讲述一个英勇无比的冒险故事。从前，有个洞穴里住着一头可怕的熊……

If you're finished with your meals, why don’t we all go back to our residences?
既然都吃完饭了，那我们不如就乖乖回到各自的住处待着吧？
dataList.title:
Jia Family
贾家

dataList.content:
You’re so angry again, Xichun. Last I heard, you lost much of your followers in a large battle, didn't you? I'm so sorry. I used more than three handkerchiefs wiping my tears away upon hearing that news.
惜春今天又发起脾气了。听说你势力的人在一场大战中伤亡惨重。真是太令人痛心了，我光是擦眼泪的手帕就用了三条还不止呢。

So the Xue family’s heard it too, huh.
看来消息已经传到薛家的耳朵里了。
dataList.title:
Jia Family
贾家

dataList.content:
You’re not wrong. But… that's irrelevant to what I've brought to the Family Hierarch war.
你说的不错。然而……这和我在家主之争中的表现无关。

Jia Family

dataList.content:
Always a big fan of your confidence, Xichun. It's a good look, you know?
惜春总是一副自信的模样，看着就令人赏心悦目呢？

Oh, that reminds me... You better watch your back, big sis Baochai. Looks like Big brother Baoyu’s learned how to sink a knife into your back with that same carefree smile.
还有……宝钗姐姐可也要注意点背后才好。我看宝玉哥哥，装得好一副傻笑的样儿，却已经把在背后捅人刀子的本事练得炉火纯青了。
dataList.title:
Jia Family
贾家

dataList.content:
What’d she mean by you knifing people in the back?
突然说什么有了背后捅别人刀子的本事，是怎么回事呢？

Ha ha, I just had a small falling out with Xichun, that's all.
哈哈，只是我和惜春的关系闹得有些僵了。

Aha! Xichun must’ve been trying to get you on her side, huh?
啊哈，看来惜春之前是想拉拢你啊！

Yeah, no wonder she wanted you on her team. Baoyu’s always excelled at whatever he does without stressing out or losing that happy smile...
难怪她想拉拢你呢，宝玉从以前开始就总是天真烂漫地笑着，实力却日就月将，精进得比谁都快。

It just kinda worked out that way~
只是，做着做着就顺利起来了呢~

I guess he can be a bit irritating like that, huh?
是有点招人嫌的性格，对吧？

… Such kind of people, though rare, indeed do exist.
……这种类型的人虽然罕见，但也并非不存在。

Oh! That reminds me, uh… um…
啊！说到这个，那个……嗯……

Did you, by any chance, run into big brother Qi... Qiu?
莫非你们遇到了丘……丘大哥吗？

I haven’t, but they have.
虽然我没看到，但他们好像见到了哦。

T-that's good...
真、真是万幸……

She placed her hand over her chest as though she'd just survived an incredibly dangerous accident, before eyeing us anxiously.
薛宝钗仿佛刚躲过一场大祸般抚着胸口长舒了一口气，又用局促不安的眼神匆匆瞥了我们一眼。

So... what happened...?
所以……发生了什么？

I do know that he was trying to ‘ally’ with Shi Yihua. I mean, it didn’t seem like anyone else was viewing that as an ‘alliance’ other than Shi Yihua himself, but…
我知道他想拉拢史易华。不过除了易华自己，似乎没人相信那叫拉拢。

It must’ve been a pretty open secret among the candidates that Jia Qiu was trying to ‘ally’ with Shi Yihua.
看来，关于贾丘试图拉拢史易华的事，已经在候选人之间暗中传开了。

Mm… they cut big brother Yihua’s head off when he was with us.
嗯……他和我们在一起的时候把易华哥哥的脑袋切下来了。

Oh my! Horizontally, or vertically?
哎呀呀，是横着切的还是竖着切的？

H.
横。

Mmh… so this is his third time, huh? Yihua’s really incorrigible. He never knows when to zip it and sit down.
嗯……这是第三次了，对吧？易华也真是的，还是改不掉他那爱轻举妄动的毛病啊。

Well, big brother Qiu… I had a feeling he’d be here when the Family Hierarch war begins. Everyone in Daguanyuan's heard that creepy song from the Backstreets, you know.
丘……大哥……我料到家主之争临近，他很快就会回来。后巷里流传的那首诡异歌谣，大观园中应该无人不晓。

Gosh, things get so awkward and hostile here at Daguanyuan every time there's any mention of him.
唉。每次消息传来，大观园的气氛就变得阴森恐怖，真是吓死人了，真的。

Well, I guess it's fortunate that he won't be coming after me once the competition begins.
不过还算幸运……丘大哥在家主之争中应该不会优先针对我。

... And why is that?
……为什么？

Because I'm simply too charming and adorable to kill outright, of course.
当然是因为我这么可爱，太早杀死我未免太可惜了。

Besides... whatever big brother Qiu's goals are... they probably have nothing to do with the Xue family.
而且……虽然不知道丘大哥的目标是什么，但至少和我们薛家无关。

Mm, I can see that.
嗯，也许是这样吧。

Baochai took a step toward Hong Lu and leaned in close to his face.
宝钗又向前了一步，凑近了鸿璐的脸。

Do you smell my fragrance still, Baoyu?
宝玉，你还能闻到我身上有好闻的香味吗？

You have never reeked, big sister Baochai.
宝钗姐姐身上从来就没散发过难闻的气味呢。

Baoyu, I've always been, and will always be, residing at <ruby=Ginger-plant Court>Hengwuyuan</ruby>. Promise to pay me a visit before you leave.
宝玉，我一直都住在蘅芜苑里。离开之前一定要来见我哦。

With that, she gracefully walked out of the room.
薛宝钗只留下了那句话，便快步走了出去。

Well, how about we also start heading back? This place can get pretty dark around Hai hour(亥時).
我们也差不多该回去了吧？这里一到亥时就会立刻变得漆黑一片呢。

You... why'd you leave...?
你……为什么要离开家……

Ha ha, she's just a childhood friend. I call her ‘big sis’ since she’s older than me... it’s just something we do here when one friend’s a bit older.
呼呼……没什么大不了的哦。她只不过是从小陪我一起玩的姐姐罢了。

She's also one of the very few in Daguanyuan who was nice to me.
在大观园里，她是为数不多的几位对我亲切的人之一。

<... So where should we head to next?>
<……那么，我们接下来该去哪儿？>

Good question. Just going by the scale of everything in here… it should be safe to expect something real ritzy, right?
说得也是呢？这园子如此奢华……这次可真的可以期待一下了吧？

You’re my guests, so you should be able to stay at my building within Daguanyuan.
既然各位是我的客人，就请在大观园中我的房间里住下吧。

It's within walking distance from here. We should be there in no time, even on foot.
离这里不远，不用坐轿子也能很快到达。
